video_title: Jalen Brunson on Facing 76ers in NBA Tip off: 'We’ll Be Ready’

quotes.speaker: Craig Melvin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the upcoming season opener against the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: they're going to be electric. They're going to be a team to keep your eye on.

text_blocks.speaker: Craig Melvin
text_blocks.text: Last hour, Mike Tirico broke the news. We're going to start the NBA season with a triple-header tip-off. You guys are going to raise that championship banner, and then after that, you're going to play a fellow named LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers, who also went out and picked up another guy who's pretty good. What do you make of that opening tip-off?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Fireworks for sure. They're going to be electric. They're going to be a team to keep your eye on. They reloaded this year, so it's going to be a tough test, but we'll be ready.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson responds to analysts calling the 76ers the team to beat
quotes.excerpt: they have a lot of firepower, but we're going to focus on what we got to do.
quotes.quote: Rightfully so. They have a lot of firepower, but we're going to focus on what we got to do and we'll see what happens.

quotes.speaker: Sandra Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandra Brunson on Jalen's rapid success as a New York Knick
quotes.excerpt: it was definitely not on the radar, but it's been a blessing.
quotes.quote: It was definitely not on the radar, but it's been a blessing. The journey with him and his father, it was all worth it. All the sacrifices, all the long days, all the ups and downs, it's all worth it.

quotes.speaker: Sandra Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandra Brunson on the benefits of being an underrated player
quotes.excerpt: to be underestimated or under the radar, kind of allows you to do just work.
quotes.quote: To be underestimated or under the radar, kind of allows you to do just work. While some people may be surprised, the people around you in your circle, they're not. So it's kind of to have that underdog mentality, there's always a place to climb, so I think it's pretty good.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the message behind his new children's book
quotes.excerpt: you don't have to have it all figured out at such a early age.
quotes.quote: You don't have to have it all figured out at such a early age. Trial and error is okay, and as long as you continue to work and believe in yourself and continue to try and try and try and never give up, the possibilities are endless.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the mission of the Second Round Foundation
quotes.excerpt: we want to instill a mindset into all, but preferably a young adults, especially in school.
quotes.quote: We want to instill a mindset into all, but preferably a young adults, especially in school, with school and sports. I've always had the Second Round Foundation, the name comes from me being a second round pick, it's kind of being overlooked. And so to kind of use that mindset of always being, regardless what people's opinions of you and what people think of you, how do you find your way to come out on top? How do you find your way to be the best version you can be regardless of the surroundings, regardless of the situation?
